newsitem.title: CHINA: China's first non-state firm BOT project finishes.
newsitem.headline: China's first non-state firm BOT project finishes.

text.p: China's first non-state BOT bridge has been completed and opened to traffic in eastern Fujian province, an official of the Quanzhou Citong Bridge Investment and Development Co said on Tuesday.
Total investment to the Citong bridge in Quanzhou city was 250 million yuan ($30.12 million), the offical said.
The company, a conglomerate of 56 private and collective firms in Quanzhou, built and would operate the bridge for 30 years before handing it over to the city government, he said.
Of the total 60 million yuan of registered capital, 60 percent of the stake was owned by the company, while the rest was held by the city government, he said by telephone.
The company would recover its investment through collecting toll fees and fees from advertisements on the bridge, he said.
The bridge, 2,000 metres long, is one of the longest bridges in Fujian province, the official said.
China has said it wants to expand the use of BOT (build, operate and transfer) projects.
